name: Games record final scores through the shared scoreboard
instruction: A game records its final score exactly once per completed round through recordScore using its own game id.
relevant_when: A TypeScript file under src/games/<game-id>/game.ts that exports a CarnivalGame object and implements round-ending logic with a score.
context: AGENTS.md says every game reports scores through src/carnival/scores.ts by calling recordScore(game.id, score) once when a round ends, and no game keeps its own high score table or talks to local storage directly.
scope_reason: The game.ts file contains the round state, end-of-round transition, score recording call, and any direct storage access within the game.

checklist.name: uses-record-score
checklist.rule: When the file has completed-round logic with a final score, it calls recordScore from src/carnival to record that final score using the exported game's own id. Return not applicable if the game has no score or no completed round state.

checklist.name: records-once-per-round
checklist.rule: The implementation guards score recording so a completed round records at most once before the next round starts. Return not applicable if the game has no score or no completed round state.

checklist.name: no-direct-score-storage
checklist.rule: The game does not use localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, or its own high score table for scores; persistent score storage is delegated to src/carnival.
